name: Kuroda Sachi
source:
Sayaka's biological mother.

Her husband died when Sayaka was in middle school. From then on, she worked desperately as an insurance salesperson, raising Sayaka into a fine young woman entirely on her own.

During this period, she met Norihiro through her work as a client.

He was a type of man she had never encountered before, and she eventually found herself swept along by his advances into an intimate adult relationship.

She wanted to send Sayaka to university, but was struggling financially. When Norihiro learned about her difficulties, he offered to help pay expenses such as Sayaka's university admission fees.

Her gratitude toward Norihiro gradually developed into romantic affection, and she now loves him deeply as her husband.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
